A different grain, on purpose. This tab is one row per Shopify DTC listing; the Items tab is one row per finished good (base Item #) across all four channels. One listing can sell several finished goods (10 oz / 5 lb / trial are separate goods sharing one page), so copy fans out through the dtc_product_items bridge instead of being flattened onto one item. Every heading below carries its source and owner as a tooltip — hover the ⓘ.
